paragraphs.en: Once upon a time, there was a magic garden behind the old castle.
paragraphs.cn: 从前，在古老的城堡后面有一个魔法花园。

paragraphs.en: In the garden, beautiful flowers could sing sweet songs every morning.
paragraphs.cn: 在花园里，美丽的花朵每天清晨都会唱起甜美的歌。

paragraphs.en: A little girl named Lily loved to play with the friendly animals there.
paragraphs.cn: 一个名叫莉莉的小女孩喜欢和那里友好的动物们一起玩耍。

paragraphs.en: One day, she found a shiny key under a big apple tree.
paragraphs.cn: 有一天，她在一棵大苹果树下发现了一把闪闪发光的钥匙。

paragraphs.en: The key opened a tiny door hidden among the green leaves.
paragraphs.cn: 这把钥匙打开了藏在绿叶中的一扇小门。

paragraphs.en: Behind the door lived a kind fairy who gave Lily a special gift.
paragraphs.cn: 门后住着一位善良的仙女，她送给莉莉一份特别的礼物。

paragraphs.en: From that day on, Lily could understand the language of all the flowers.
paragraphs.cn: 从那天起，莉莉就能听懂所有花朵的语言了。
